newsitem.title: USA: Serv-Tech Q4 net shr loss $0.80 vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Serv-Tech Q4 net shr loss $0.80 vs profit.

text.p: For the Three Months For the Year

NOTES: Two special items are included in the 1996 results from continuing operations: (1) a $3.5 million ($2.3 million, or $0.35 per share, after-tax) charge to second quarter 1996 earnings to reflect impairment of certain obsolete equipment, write-off of an uncollectible receivable, severance costs.
(2) the $5.8 million ($3.9 million, or $0.57 per share, on an after-tax basis) net proceeds from the Stewart & Stevenson award recorded in the third quarter of 1996.
Excluding the effect of these special items, the company generated a net loss from continuing operations for the year ended December 31, 1996, of $4.0 million, or $0.60 per share.

During the 1966 fourth quarter, the company recorded an increase to the loss for discontinuing operations of $4.5 million ($2.9 million, or $0.43 per share, on an after-tax basis). The charge represents an increase in the reserves associated with the remaining international engine, procurement and construction project, which it said it expects to be completed in the later part of 1997.
